name: Growave
description: Growave is a Shopify retention platform for loyalty and rewards, referrals, reviews, wishlists, gift registries, customer profiles, galleries, and user-generated content.
agentUseSummary: Growave cannot yet be connected through Relay. API access requires a Plus-or-higher merchant to create a store-owned token with explicit resource scopes and an expiration policy in Growave Admin; representative credential, entitlement, and token-lifecycle acceptance is required first.

credentialRequirements.name: GROWAVE_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Growave API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Dedicated scoped merchant token stored only in Railway's encrypted credential boundary.

blocked.label: Collect a Growave token
blocked.description: Relay does not collect a merchant token before representative plan, scope, expiration, revocation, and rotation acceptance.

blocked.label: Collect broad API key and secret
blocked.description: Relay does not replace a least-authority custom token with the merchant's broader account API key and secret.

blocked.label: Read Growave data
blocked.description: Customers, rewards, reviews, wishlists, galleries, gift registries, loyalty, and account data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Mutate or use raw Growave APIs
blocked.description: Customer, reward, review, wishlist, gift-registry, app-install and webhook changes, arbitrary endpoints, pagination, and raw responses are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Growave action is enabled before representative merchant credential and entitlement acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: No Growave wrappers are mounted until a representative Plus merchant establishes the frozen token contract.
No Growave wrappers are mounted until a representative Plus merchant establishes the frozen token contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Growave's developer toolkit is available on Plus and higher plans. A merchant must create a dedicated token in Growave Admin, select read/write resource scopes, choose a 7-, 30-, 90-day or non-expiring lifetime, and securely transfer the one credential; public documentation does not prove exact token formatting, rotation behavior, representative product entitlements, or denial schemas.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should obtain authorization from a representative Plus merchant, create a dedicated token with only read_customer and read_reward and a bounded expiration without exposing it in reports, store it in Railway, and return exact-store binding, rotation, revocation, expiry, schema, quota, denial, and privacy-redaction evidence before connector implementation.

evidence.supports: Growave states the API tab is available on Plus and higher plans and lets merchants create, manage, and revoke tokens with resource-specific read/write scopes and 7-, 30-, 90-day or non-expiring lifetimes.

Growave documents HTTPS bearer authentication, OAuth2 access-token retrieval from merchant API credentials, a 60-request bucket leaking at three requests per second, and broad data and mutation endpoints.
Growave documents server-side REST requests and webhook subscriptions for retrieving and updating Growave services alongside customer-facing SDKs.
